name: handler_notifier
title: Progression Handler: Progress Reported via the Operating-System Notification Framework (GUI, Text)

origin.description: Build a progression handler that posts notifier alerts.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default reads progressr.intrusiveness.notifier, or 10.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "gui".

origin.value: A function of class progression_handler. On this machine the package lookup stops before that function is returned.
origin.example:
err <- tryCatch(handler_notifier(), error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
cat("handler_notifier() errors: ", err, ".\n", sep = "")
